notes: NMMEA has published its 2026-2027 calendar (choir All-State audition window and the January 2027 All-State Music Festival), and states that audition registration opens September 1, 2026. However, the choir audition-material document linked from the Vocal Auditions page is still headed '2025 All-State Choir Audition Material', so the specific 2026-27 choral audition excerpt is NOT yet confirmed and has been deliberately omitted from repertoire. Audition format requirements are recorded from that document but flagged as prior-season wording.

organization.name: New Mexico Music Educators Association
organization.description: NMMEA is New Mexico's state music education association. It administers statewide All-State auditions for choir, guitar, orchestra, band and jazz, and hosts the annual All-State Music Festival and In-Service Conference.

sources.name: NMMEA All-State Choir Audition Material (Google Doc)

programs.name: All-State Choir
programs.description: NMMEA's All-State Choir, selected by statewide audition and performing at the NMMEA All-State Music Festival and In-Service Conference.

dates.title: Audition registration opens
dates.description: NMMEA states 'Audition Registration will open September 1, 2026.'

dates.title: Choir, Guitar & Orchestra All-State Auditions
dates.description: Audition window published on the NMMEA 2026-2027 dates page.

requirements.title: Three-part audition: prepared solo, choral audition excerpt, sight-reading
requirements.description: NMMEA's linked choir audition-material document (headed '2025 All-State Choir Audition Material' at time of retrieval) describes an audition consisting of a memorized prepared solo performed with piano accompaniment, a memorized choral audition excerpt performed against a backing track with the auditioned part muted, and a sight-reading exercise.

requirements.title: Prepared solo requirements
requirements.description: Solo must demonstrate range, tone quality, technical ability and artistry; must be performed with piano accompaniment (a cappella solos not accepted); must be memorized; the solo audition is stopped at two minutes regardless of the length of the selection.

requirements.title: Sight-reading exercise
requirements.description: Students sing an eight-measure sight-reading exercise; sight-reading parameters are given in the NMMEA handbook, and piano introductions in all keys are provided in NMMEA resource folders.

requirements.title: Home-school students register separately
requirements.description: Home-school students and students attending schools without music programs may not be registered through the standard vocal All-State registration form; parents must contact NMMEA for registration information.
